comment: Real-world skill corpus: verbatim snapshots of public skills used as regression fixtures. Do not edit the snapshot files; re-snapshot from the pinned source instead. Sources are re-fetched and re-pinned deliberately, never automatically.

anthropics/skills.licenseNote: Per-skill LICENSE.txt (Apache-2.0) is copied with each snapshot; file-edge whitespace (leading blank line, final newline) is normalized by the GitHub web editor, license text unchanged. The docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx skills in that repo are source-available, not open source, and are excluded.

obra/superpowers.licenseNote: MIT LICENSE at the repository root covers all skills; not copied per-skill because the upstream skills carry no per-skill license file.

brand-guidelines.note: Passes cleanly; covers a plain scalar frontmatter plus an extra license key.

academy-guide.note: Folded block scalar description (description: >). One documented finding: the placeholder link [Title](URL) in a blockquote example is reported as ref-exists at SKILL.md:82:40. Recorded as a known false positive candidate, not edited, because corpus files stay verbatim.

discernment-nudge.note: Folded block scalar description with a content line that starts with an em dash; passes cleanly.

requesting-code-review.note: Two-file skill whose SKILL.md links code-reviewer.md at the skill root; passes cleanly.
